body:
Six agents today each needed the same briefing: in a worktree, create your OWN server venv (the main
checkout's editable install imports the main checkout's code, not yours); symlink web/node_modules
rather than npm install (it rewrites the lockfile and the gate now fails on drift); write
android/local.properties; stop the Gradle daemon when done. Also the split that worked: agents commit
on their branch and never touch gittoc; the orchestrator reviews the diff, cherry-picks onto main, runs
the gate, closes the ticket, removes the worktree. And the commit trailer: every agent flagged that
the harness asks for a different Co-Authored-By than the repo uses — state the repo's exactly.
title: AGENTS.md: how agents work in worktrees, who closes tickets, and the exact commit trailer
